services.desc: The Audain Art Museum team is excited to have launched guided school programs that complement BC curriculums and enrich the education of children and youth. The Museum has dedicated Wednesdays to hosting student groups. To be added to the distribution list for school program information, please contact connect@audainartmuseum.com. Thank you for your interest. By studying stories and transformation through a piece of art, or a body of work, students can appreciate the rich cultural history, the evolution of style and identity, and/or the mythological or evocative commentary of the artist.
